scope: Only closing scene folio of each of six official matchups
incident: P11 image omitted end-of-match score plaque despite complete source. Subsequent generative retries reversed story and fabricated unapproved speech. Failure: visual production QA/checkpoints never enforced a visible final score.

policy.not_for: Any other scene page unless specifically commissioned; never invent premature sports outcome on setup or combat page
policy.artifact_gate: For all six payoff pages, an explicit FINAL RESULT visual banner with correct winning/losing franchise and two-decimal scores is mandatory, checked at 1080x1920 and 390x693 before founder submission. The source manifest is a mechanical input check, not proof that pixels actually show it.
policy.refusal: Reject and repair missing/mistyped banner by local targeted typography overlay of accepted artwork; NEVER regenerate the story scene, winner, speaker or survival outcome solely because a receipt is absent.
policy.render_output: Approved art plate with exact deterministic score type. Prose untouched.
policy.approved_folio_rule: No on-art F##/P## page IDs in the banner
